cases.name: Kasmine L. McAfee
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kasmine graduated from Alexandria High School in 2020. She was a beautiful soul. Her family describes her as a great daughter and an awesome mother. She loved doing hair and just being around people who loved her, She was very charismatic, funny, humble, and irreplaceable. She will be missed and loved forever."
